goal: Make Planner Specs declare their threat model and supported environment and write acceptance as enumerated negative cases with focused verification descriptors.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S4 in docs/specs/review-convergence.spec.md: the imm-planner contract and its dist mirror require a threat model and supported environment declaration for Specs with external input, require concrete enumerated negative cases instead of absolute any-malformed-input clauses, and require focused test-file descriptors rather than whole suites.
